programme.title: Sadhu Aur Shaitaan
programme.desc: Sher Khan, a criminal, decides to rob a bank. However, his life takes a dramatic turn when he meets a kind-hearted taxi driver.

programme.title: Chandan Ka Palna
programme.desc: Ajit's perfect marriage to Shobha turns upside down after she starts behaving strangely with him and his mother, leading to a disturbed life.

programme.title: Ankhiyon Ke Jharokhon Se
programme.desc: College competitors Lily and Arun gradually fall in love and soon, both their parents approve of their relationship. However, their lives turn upside down when she is diagnosed with leukaemia.

programme.title: Hamara Khandan
programme.desc: Vishal, who hails from a wealthy Hindu family, falls in love with Ruby, a poor Catholic girl. While her father approves of the marriage, his father does his best to stop them from marrying.

programme.title: Gehra Zakhm
programme.desc: This is Film - Drama Category

programme.title: Aadmi Aur Insaan
programme.desc: Jai and Munish fall for the same girl, ruining their bond with each other. However, an unfortunate turn of events reveals the true nature of their friendship.

programme.title: Saudagar
programme.desc: Moti betrays his loyal wife and business partner, Majubee, to marry his true love, Phoolbanu. However, his selfish act unleashes unforeseen consequences that upend his life.

programme.title: Daku Aur Jawan
programme.desc: Ramu sets out on a path of revenge after his brother is framed in a rape and murder case.

programme.title: Ek Nari Ek Brahmachari
programme.desc: Raj lives with his brother, Mohan, who has taken a vow of celibacy. Trouble brews when Neena, along with her son, walks into their house and claims that Mohan is the father of her child.

programme.title: Mere Bhaiya
programme.desc: A girl tries to reconcile her father and her brother, because she loves both very much. She tries to reform her brother by making sacrifices, which shakes his core.

programme.title: Anamika
programme.desc: A writer rescues an injured woman who suffers from memory loss but claims to be his wife. In the process of finding out her real identity, he falls in love with her.

programme.title: Mulzim
programme.desc: A farmer wants to build a hospital in his village, but is at odds with a landlord who wants to build a theatre on the same land. To get him out of the way, the landlord frames the farmer for murder.

programme.title: Khandan
programme.desc: Radha marries a kind-hearted Govind who is paralysed due to an accident. Though Govind highly respects his uncle and aunt, a property dispute forces them to live like strangers under the same roof.

programme.title: Dost
programme.desc: A forest ranger joins hands with locals to prevent large-scale poaching that is prevalent in the nearby forests. However, his efforts infuriate a poaching baron who vows to exact revenge.

programme.title: Himmatwala
programme.desc: After being humiliated by an autocratic landlord, a temple priest kills himself. Later, the priest's son returns to the village seeking revenge.

programme.title: The Accidental Prime Minister
programme.desc: Amidst the political upheaval, Dr Manmohan Singh, an Indian economist, faces several challenges during his tenure as the Prime Minister of India.

programme.title: Videsh
programme.desc: A drug lord kidnaps a CBI officer's daughter to stop his investigation.

programme.title: Teri Maang Sitaron Se Bhar Doon
programme.desc: Kamini pretends to be wealthy in front of her daughter, while living a contradictory reality. However, her life takes a surprising turn when her boss, an outlaw named Sultanbhai, comes to her rescue.

programme.title: Upkar
programme.desc: Radha's elder son sacrifices his ambitions to ensure his brother Puran gets a good education. Despite this, Puran grows up to become a ruthless man.

programme.title: Pyaasa Sawan
programme.desc: Chandrakant, a wealthy man, observes his son Ravi neglecting his wife for his career and decides to intervene to save Ravi's marriage.

programme.title: Immaan Dharam
programme.desc: Petty crooks Ahmed and Mohan decide to change their ways after meeting the virtuous Kabir Das. However, when Kabir is implicated in a murder case, the duo decides to help him but gets into trouble.

programme.title: Karz
programme.desc: Monty discovers the shocking truth about his past life when he was killed by his gold-digger wife, while his family was rendered homeless. Supported by his lover, he decides to set things right.

programme.title: Shalimar
programme.desc: Kumar, a thief, aspires to be mafia boss Sir John's successor by stealing Shalimar, a priceless diamond. Adamant to succeed in his mission, Kumar must overcome many tribulations to seize the diamond.

programme.title: Lok Sangeet
programme.desc: Talented artists perform some of their most popular folk music compositions in an effort to spread awareness about the culture.

programme.title: Charcha Mein

programme.title: Gowramma
